title: Jon Gruden "fired up" to broadcast Bucs preseason game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jon Gruden "fired up" to broadcast Bucs preseason game
sources.description: Jon Gruden, who won Super Bowl XXXVII as Tampa Bay's head coach, will be in the broadcast booth as the play-by-play announcer for the Bucs' second preseason game against the Chiefs on Aug. 22.
